Source introduction:

April Chan is a member of the East Bay Municipal Utility District Board of Directors in California, representing Ward 7. Chan assumed office on January 1, 2023. Chan's current term ends on December 31, 2026.
Chan is running for re-election to the East Bay Municipal Utility District Board of Directors to represent Ward 7 in California. Chan is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Chan completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.

A named voter guide/Sway voting group is a recommendation, not automatically a formal endorsement. Keep awards/designations distinct; do not turn generic mention, donations, candidate opponents, or lists of candidates this person endorsed into endorsements OF this candidate. The generic boilerplate combines endorsements and recommendations: use the specific entry and its category. Do not rely on URL filenames alone. Hold ambiguous cases.

criteria.endorsed: The source reports this named entity endorsing this candidate

criteria.distinction: An award, badge or program distinction
criteria.unrelated: Mention, navigation, donor, opponent or reverse endorsement
